docs.summary: One chunk of triangle geometry contributed to a navmesh bake: source-local vertices and indices plus the transform into world space. Collected from renderers, colliders, terrain, or supplied directly by user code for procedural geometry.
Sentinel for [`Area`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshGeometrySource~Area): the source takes the bake's default area.

The navigation area for this geometry (index into [`NavMeshAreas`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshAreas)). Walkable polygons rasterized from this source carry this area, so per-source costs and masks apply. [`UnspecifiedArea`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshGeometrySource~UnspecifiedArea) (the constructor default) falls back to the bake's default area. Where surfaces of different areas overlap vertically within the climb threshold, the HIGHER area index wins the merged span (Recast's convention) — not the higher cost — so order user areas accordingly when stacking geometry.
